Every grid endpoint and all four probe arrows follow the same A_t, including (1,0)->(2,1), with original 8-second path and fixed reference axes.

units.function: Derive the product condition with every intermediate reason.

Preserve 3x=lambda x -> lambda=3 with original 2-second semantic movement and the explicit x!=0 division reason.
Keep v=x(1,1), x!=0, as the entire nonzero direction, not one arrow.

units.function: Solve the other case and explain exhaustion of all nonzero vectors.

Substitute lambda=1 to show 2x+y=x.
Preserve 2x+y=x -> x+y=0 with the original 3-second semantic movement.
Preserve x+y=0 -> y=-x with the original 3-second semantic movement.
Keep v=x(1,-1), x!=0, and explain that equal or unequal covers every nonzero vector.

units.function: Connect decomposition, independent scaling and recomposition to the direct matrix image.

Keep original 9-second common A_t motion: first component scales by 1+2t, second stays unchanged, joined endpoint equals direct A_tu at every instant.

units.function: A real-number counterexample and its reason.

Keep original 5-second true 90-degree rotation at constant length, fixed original-line reference and common coordinate units.

units.function: Return to the same matrix and explain the eigenvalue.

Keep Av=lambda v, v!=0, A(1,1)=3(1,1), A(1,-1)=(1,-1) and eigenvalues as multiples on the original line.
